SMTO-SKL-0117 — SMTO needs to know which Slack workspace to use

GUID: 09a7dfe5-d5ef-597a-b47b-edde66714af7
Slug: slack-workspace-ambiguous
Domain: SKL · Subsystem: slack

What happened

  • More than one Slack connection is saved, and this request didn't say which to use. One workspace can even have two: one acting as you and one as a bot. SMTO won't guess, so nothing was sent to Slack.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Ask SMTO to list your Slack workspaces, and note the entry you want, including whether it acts as you (user) or as a bot. Each connection has its own name, and user and bot connections can do different things.
  2. Write your request again, type @, and pick that Slack workspace entry from the list. A mention tells SMTO exactly which connection to use, so it no longer has to choose.

What success looks like

  • SMTO uses the Slack workspace you mentioned and doesn't ask you to choose again.

If it still fails

  • Select Copy error details and send it to the person who manages SMTO. Don't disconnect other Slack workspaces just to leave one; mentioning the one you want is enough.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • Slack workspace resolution found several accepted or connected slack_workspace profiles and the request carried no single explicit workspace_ref, so it returned the candidate references instead of choosing one.

What this means

  • Workspace selection finds multiple profiles without one exact accepted or explicit selection. The diagnostic performs no Slack request. Inspect the original receipt and operation stage to determine effects; keep workspace, principal and exact channel/message identities fixed during recovery.

Why this can happen

  • Workspace selection finds multiple profiles without one exact accepted or explicit selection.

How to diagnose it

  • Inspect workspace_ref and principal type rather than selecting the first profile.

How to fix it

  • Choose the exact workspace_ref and principal (user or bot) from slack.workspaces or the workspace_refs in the error details, and pass it explicitly or as one @ reference. A workspace with both bot and user grants has two profiles; SlackProfiles.workspace never picks by scope or list order.
  • Choose the exact workspace_ref and principal from slack.workspaces; a workspace with bot and user grants has two profiles.

Retry and execution caution

  • Inspect exact provider state and authority first.

How to verify the fix

  • One exact intended workspace/principal profile is supplied.

What not to do

  • Do not expose secrets or blindly replay uncertain mutations.

Technical notes

  • The diagnostic performs no Slack request. Inspect the original receipt and operation stage to determine effects; keep workspace, principal and exact channel/message identities fixed during recovery.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
